content:
name: EOSM MNT-0002 Projection Freshness Follow-up

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosm/fix-eosv-execution-projection-freshness

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  EOS_ACTOR: chatgpt

jobs:
  repair:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Enter exact maintenance baseline
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          BASE_SHA="a0eb366f33c7c551d5bdadacf47df6f36f17585d"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE_SHA"
          git reset --hard "$BASE_SHA"
          test ! -e .github/workflows/eosm-projection-freshness-followup.yml
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

      - name: Exclude generated machine projections from execution workspace fingerprint
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path

          verifier = Path('tools/eos/verification_v2.py')
          text = verifier.read_text()
          old = 'excluded=(".eos/","engineering/evidence/","engineering/reviews/")'
          new = 'excluded=(".eos/","machine/","engineering/evidence/","engineering/reviews/")'
          assert text.count(old) == 1
          text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
          old = 'pathspec=[".",":(exclude).eos/**",":(exclude)engineering/evidence/**",":(exclude)engineering/reviews/**"]'
          new = 'pathspec=[".",":(exclude).eos/**",":(exclude)machine/**",":(exclude)engineering/evidence/**",":(exclude)engineering/reviews/**"]'
          assert text.count(old) == 1
          verifier.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

          test = Path('scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py')
          text = test.read_text()
          anchor = '''        assert "source fingerprint changed" not in audited["issues"], audited\n\n        # Real execution-source drift must still be detected relative to\n'''
          insert = '''        assert "source fingerprint changed" not in audited["issues"], audited\n\n        # EOSV machine projections are generated outputs, not execution\n        # source. Rewriting and committing them after evidence capture must\n        # not stale execution-bound evidence. This reproduces the real\n        # capture -> machine sync -> commit sequence that blocked WP-MVP-0002.\n        projection = root / "machine" / "projection.json"\n        projection.write_text(\n            '{"projection": "refreshed"}\\n',\n            encoding="utf-8",\n        )\n        run("git", "add", "machine/projection.json", cwd=root)\n        run("git", "commit", "-qm", "machine projection refresh", cwd=root)\n\n        execution_after_projection, projection_payload = (\n            module.source_fingerprint(\n                "WP-TEST-0001",\n                "EXEC-TEST-0001",\n            )\n        )\n        assert execution_after_projection == execution_initial, projection_payload\n\n        projection_audit, failures = module.audit_evidence(mutate=False)\n        assert not failures, failures\n        projection_row = next(\n            row for row in projection_audit if row["id"] == "EVID-TEST-0001"\n        )\n        assert (\n            "source fingerprint changed" not in projection_row["issues"]\n        ), projection_row\n\n        # Real execution-source drift must still be detected relative to\n'''
          assert text.count(anchor) == 1
          test.write_text(text.replace(anchor, insert, 1))

          mnt = Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md')
          text = mnt.read_text()
          assert '**State:** VERIFYING' in text
          marker = '## Closure criterion\n'
          addition = '''## Additional root cause discovered during real-workflow verification\n\nAfter PR #192 corrected target/execution reconstruction, the real WP-MVP-0002 EOSV workflow exposed a second self-reference in the same freshness defect: `workspace_hash()` excluded EOS control/evidence outputs but still included generated `machine/**` projections. EOSV captures evidence before machine-document synchronization, so the subsequent projection rewrite changed the execution workspace hash even though executable and governing source state was unchanged.\n\nThe execution workspace fingerprint must therefore exclude `machine/**`, consistent with non-execution source freshness, while retaining substantive source/workspace drift detection.\n\n## Additional verification\n\n- [ ] A committed machine-projection-only refresh leaves execution-bound evidence fresh while a real implementation-source change still stales it.\n\n'''
          assert marker in text and 'machine-projection-only refresh' not in text
          mnt.write_text(text.replace(marker, addition + marker, 1))
          PY

      - name: Verify expanded maintenance fix
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 -m py_compile tools/eos/verification_v2.py scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          python3 scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          p=Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md')
          text=p.read_text()
          item='- [ ] A committed machine-projection-only refresh leaves execution-bound evidence fresh while a real implementation-source change still stales it.'
          assert item in text
          p.write_text(text.replace(item, item.replace('[ ]','[x]'), 1))
          PY

          ./scripts/eos validate WP-MVP-0001 --profile wp
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Assert scope and MNT state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import csv

          verifier=Path('tools/eos/verification_v2.py').read_text()
          assert 'excluded=(".eos/","machine/","engineering/evidence/","engineering/reviews/")' in verifier
          assert ':(exclude)machine/**' in verifier

          test=Path('scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py').read_text()
          assert 'machine projection refresh' in test
          assert 'execution_after_projection == execution_initial' in test

          mnt=Path('engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002.md').read_text()
          assert '**State:** VERIFYING' in mnt
          assert '- [x] A committed machine-projection-only refresh leaves execution-bound evidence fresh while a real implementation-source change still stales it.' in mnt
          row=next(r for r in csv.DictReader(open('.eos/maintenance.tsv'),delimiter='\t') if r['id']=='MNT-0002')
          assert row['status']=='VERIFYING', row

          evidence=list(csv.DictReader(open('.eos/evidence.tsv'),delimiter='\t'))
          current=[r for r in evidence if r.get('target')=='WP-MVP-0001' and r.get('status')!='SUPERSEDED']
          assert len(current)==3 and all(r['status']=='VALIDATED' for r in current), current
          PY

          allowed='^(tools/eos/verification_v2\.py|scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness\.py|engineering/maintenance/MNT-0002\.md|\.eos/|machine/|engineering/evidence/)'
          unexpected="$(git diff --name-only | grep -Ev "$allowed" || true)"
          test -z "$unexpected" || { printf 'Unexpected maintenance scope:\n%s\n' "$unexpected" >&2; exit 1; }
          git diff --stat

      - name: Commit prove stable and publish isolated follow-up
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          FINAL_BRANCH="eosm/fix-eosv-execution-projection-freshness-final"
          git config user.name 'PMB CI'
          git config user.email 'ci@pmb.test'
          git add -A
          git commit -m 'fix(eosv): exclude generated projections from execution freshness'
          python3 scripts/test-eosv-evidence-freshness.py
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "a0eb366f33c7c551d5bdadacf47df6f36f17585d"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$FINAL_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Final follow-up branch already exists" >&2; exit 1
          fi
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$FINAL_BRANCH"
